summary: Validated session-expired alert dedup fix. With bogus token, navigating to /admin/projects (3 parallel GETs: /projects, /service-orders, /projects/_/supervisors) produced EXACTLY 1 window.alert 'Sessão expirada...' and redirected to '/'. Token+user cleared from localStorage. Happy-path login also produced 0 alerts.
critical_code_review_comments: sessionExpiredShown guard is reset after fixed 3s timer; if user is slow to see the alert, could theoretically re-fire on retry — acceptable trade-off.

onSessionExpiredHandler branch does NOT reset sessionExpiredShown after handler runs; if handler is registered (React Native path), a second logout attempt could be silently swallowed until 3s passes. Consider resetting guard inside/after handler branch too for symmetry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix in /app/frontend/services/api.ts (sessionExpiredShown guard + error.sessionExpired flag) works as intended. Verified via localStorage.setItem('token','bogus') then navigating /admin/projects. Dialog counter via page.on('dialog') = 1. Final URL = root. Token cleared. If retesting, note: React Native Web uses localStorage as AsyncStorage backend — confirmed working.
rca of the issue: N/A — validation only, no bug found.
